doc.prompt_input_usage: Auto-resizing input for AI prompts. Includes send/attach buttons, handles Enter for send and Shift+Enter for newline.
doc.smart_search_input_usage: Input field that seamlessly expands from a standard search bar to an AI prompt. Supports transition from single-line search to multi-line dialogue.
doc.streaming_text_usage: Real-time Markdown rendering for LLM generated text. Includes a blinking cursor during streaming and aria-live notifications.
doc.thought_process_usage: Visualizes AI reasoning steps in a timeline. Features collapsible containers showing step status (running, completed, error).
doc.ai_patterns_desc: Combine `PromptInput` and `StreamingText` to build simple AI chat interfaces.
doc.ai_best_practices_loading: Set `loading={true}` on `PromptInput` while AI is generating a response to prevent duplicate submissions.
doc.ai_best_practices_streaming: Switch `isStreaming={false}` on `StreamingText` after completion to hide the cursor and stop `aria-live` updates.
doc.ai_best_practices_error: Display error messages in `StreamingText` content or use a separate `Alert` component when errors occur.
